description: RCA gate benchmark. Scores the fusion and gating decision only, not the full workflow.
scope: Each case gives an evidence signature, the deterministic classifier result, and the domain that turned out to be true.

cases.signature: Modem reachable, downstream power and MER nominal, subscribed tier does not match the active config file
Gateway reboots every few minutes, firmware behind current approved build, plant levels clean
Wired throughput meets tier, wireless is poor in distant rooms, 2.4GHz airtime saturated
Upstream ingress noise observed on four subscribers sharing one tap, aerial plant near the coast, fittings green with corrosion
cases.note: rules WRONG: multi-subscriber ingress is tap, not drop

cases.signature: Low upstream power at a single premise, levels at the tap measured correct, weathered drop cable with cracked jacket
Downstream power measured low at the tap port itself, amplifier upstream reads nominal, several premises affected
cases.note: rules WRONG: measured low AT the tap

cases.signature: Intermittent MER dips at one address only, neighbours on the same tap unaffected, ground block oxidised
Simultaneous errors across most CPEs on one node, node utilisation pinned at capacity all evening
Amplifier alarm and degraded levels across an entire node leg after overnight storm, mains supply fault
ONT registered, optical Rx inside budget, service VLAN wrong following a tariff change
ONT reports dying gasp then re-registers, local mains unstable, optical levels nominal throughout
Optical Rx marginal at one ONT, reading at the drop terminal within budget, patch cord kinked behind the unit
Optical Rx degraded for six ONTs behind a single splitter port, port face contaminated
cases.note: rules WRONG: group behind one ODP port

cases.signature: Loss of signal across every ONT on one distribution point, feeder fibre cut by third-party excavation
Measured ODN loss at the distribution point exceeds design budget, individual premise drops all within spec
cases.note: rules WRONG: loss measured AT the ODP

cases.signature: Single ONT optical Rx low, distribution point within budget, drop fibre crushed beneath a driveway conduit
OLT PON port alarm affecting all ONTs on the port, transceiver diagnostics degraded
Optical path clean end to end, ONT Ethernet negotiates fine, wireless coverage poor upstairs
